component: production release artifact integrity for democratized.space
impact: Production democratized.space served later 3.1-era frontend and changelog content while the footer, /healthz, and /livez still reported prod v3.0.1. The unintended 3.1-era frontend also made the non-working token.place prototype the default /chat path for fresh/default profiles; OpenAI required a manual /settings opt-in and the user's own valid API key, so it was not an automatic fallback. Exact user-impact start, affected sessions, failed chat attempts, precise token.place failure mode, and impact to already-persisted OpenAI users were not captured. Service availability remained healthy, and no evidence showed data loss, save corruption, credential exposure, privacy/security compromise, staging impact, token.place users outside DSPACE, or impact to other Sugarkube applications.
rootCause: Release-artifact mutability was the primary control failure: ordinary eligible branch image builds could publish the semantic v<package-version> tag as well as immutable branch-SHA tags. Because the package version remained 3.0.1 while later main-branch changes accumulated, later source revisions could be published under v3.0.1. Production used v3.0.1 with image.pullPolicy=Always, so the strongest evidence-supported causal mechanism is that a later source revision was resolved under the moved v3.0.1 tag when the observed production pods were created or restarted. The exact workflow run, pre-recovery digest, and semantic tag prior/final digests were not captured. A separate published OCI chart dspace:3.0.1 mismatch was discovered during recovery and complicated Helm reconciliation, but it is not treated as the primary source of the user-visible frontend drift.
resolution: The operator first restored canonical v3.0.1 source 1a31a569aff2dbeb238e8c2688b9e85140d2077d with immutable image main-1a31a56 at sha256:23dbc573377549136c1f10b05706b3c176ffbabaf04a3194381a24752104a401. A later controlled reconciliation deployed recovery chart 3.0.2 at sha256:8b862135e52146f301a41259d6dabb053ed891d798fc1c8c95ca775b2b8e9575 and recorded production Helm revision 9. The finalized immutable Sugarkube evidence proves Git, Helm, Deployment, pod image IDs, runtime and frontend identities, expected OpenAI provider, replicas, public/direct responses, and /chat agree. All 25 labeled follow-up issues are closed; the nine DSPACE mirrors of Sugarkube work were closed not planned rather than counted as additional controls.
verification: Final production evidence is deployment-evidence/dspace/prod/main-1a31a56-20260801T093443Z.json in Sugarkube.

The finalized record verifies DSPACE 3.0.1 source 1a31a569aff2dbeb238e8c2688b9e85140d2077d, image main-1a31a56 and its digest, chart 3.0.2 and its digest/source, Helm revision 9, OpenAI provider, runtime/frontend identities, replica and public/direct agreement, and /chat.

DSPACE v3.1.1 release validation proved source 22f506e07e0b5abfd0cf756e9c5827c0458fb4b2, immutable image main-22f506e, semantic alias v3.1.1, and image digest sha256:467890df969cc7938cb760f965fd8f90a8912b1dcb1f8425bc808216b7e1512b agree with chart 3.1.2 at sha256:544a3e31ab827e6d2bf28754a19d8af17b0402b75159c2a40c1b3dfe5eb60161.
The v3.1.1 semantic publication succeeded, and a deliberate duplicate attempt was rejected before republication.

Sugarkube staging observability revision 8 proved five DSPACE integrity alerts, a five-minute pinned /chat synthetic, PagerDuty firing/acknowledgement/resolution, exact drill-rule deletion, and clean steady state. Production observability was not deployed or live-tested by that drill.
